# Synthetic Project Fixture — Noura Coffee

## Customer
Noura Coffee is a fictional independent specialty coffee shop opening a flagship location in Tehran.

## Audience
Young professionals, designers, architects, and university students, approximately 20–35.

## Objective
Create a visual identity that differentiates Noura from generic specialty coffee brands and communicates a contemporary, intelligent, calm, creative, distinctly Iranian character.

## Desired perception
Contemporary, intelligent, calm, creative, culturally connected to Iran without looking traditionally Persian.

## Applications
Store signage, coffee cups, packaging, Instagram, menu, and website.

## Preferences
Minimal layouts, strong typography, muted natural colors, tactile materials, contemporary editorial design.

## Avoid
Bright colors, excessive decoration, stereotypical Persian motifs, overly luxurious aesthetics, excessive nostalgia.

## Constraints
Must work across physical and digital applications and remain recognizable at small sizes. Budget is medium. Timeline is approximately three months.

## Unknowns
Specific competitors, specific visual references, existing identity assets, detailed production specifications, exact budget, geographic scope, and brand-story rationale are not supplied.

## Testing purpose
This fixture is synthetic and exists only to test pipeline execution, provenance, unknown handling, requirement extraction, handoffs, and semantic quality. It must not be treated as real customer research.
